method: Direct inspection of immutable artifact bytes against the artifact's own declared AsyncAPI edition and the governing openbindings.asyncapi@1 candidate. Neither SDK's acceptance or rejection is used as the oracle. Every reason code observed in a corpus residual must appear here with exactly one classification (development-loop.md MC1).

classificationPolicy.doctrine-refused: Representing it would require an unwarranted or fidelity-damaging project convention. Permanent by design until that judgment changes. Carries a revisit trigger describing the evidence that would reopen it.
classificationPolicy.upstream-defective: The artifact violates its own declared upstream specification. Not this project's gap; excluded from the supported-artifact denominator.
classificationPolicy.economically-deferred: A faithful widening exists but measured prevalence is below the floor. Records the measured number and the revisit trigger.
classificationPolicy.implementation-debt: NOT a valid terminal classification. Per MC2 an implementation loss can never be laundered by adjudication; entries carrying this classification are open work items and block measured-complete.
classificationPolicy.derivative: Not independently adjudicable; the code is emitted as a consequence of another exclusion and shrinks when that one resolves.
classificationPolicy.resolved-widened: Historical: the reason code no longer occurs because a ruled widening represented the class. The entry records the ruling and the corpus effect; it does not classify a live residual.
classificationPolicy.superseded-narrowing: Historical: a ruled change removed the exclusion's constraint; the code narrows to a residual capability bound recorded in the entry. Not a live doctrine classification.

entries.authority: openbindings.asyncapi.md §9.2: the first candidate defines no per-message payload-and-headers envelope; a target whose application contract requires headers at the OpenBindings boundary is an explicit synthesis exclusion.
entries.rationale: Admitting headers would require either an envelope in the operation schema (protocol recompilation, forbidden by ABSTRACTION-FIDELITY.md) or a generic headers member on the invocation frames (explicitly rejected). The exclusion is the faithful outcome.
entries.revisitTrigger: none — the residual per-cell bound retires per protocol as driver header mapping lands (Kafka record headers, HTTP headers, MQTT 5 user properties, AMQP application-properties).
entries.status: EXECUTED 2026-08-14 (envelope block): the reason code no longer occurs
entries.note: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-14 (headers-envelope corollary of the channel-parameters ruling): the exclusion's load-bearing constraint — no envelope in the operation schema — was removed when the routed one-tuple envelope entered the family for channel parameters. Message.headers is application data by AsyncAPI's own definition and varies per message (the amortization discriminator: per-invocation values are operation input/output); declared headers now ride the routed envelope beside the payload on both directions. The frames-level rejection stands untouched: the invoker wire contract never learns a headers member. The exclusion NARROWS to protocol cells without native header carriage (MQTT 3.1.1) — a per-cell capability bound like the driver matrix, not a doctrine. Execution folded into the parameters-envelope block, staged after the parameter lane proves the mechanism. EXECUTED 2026-08-14: the routed envelope landed in both SDKs (spec §9.2, ASYNC-SS-01/SS-21, envelope.go/synthesize.ts) — declared headers ride the envelope's headers field per message, location-less channel parameters ride it as input fields, and every formerly excluded cell is represented (408 coverage entries → 0 at corpus tag asyncapi-at1-envelope; fullyRepresented specimens 253 → 293). The residual per-cell carriage bound is an INVOCATION capability only (HTTP-field carriage QUALIFIED 2026-08-14 in all three engines; KAFKA RECORD-HEADER carriage QUALIFIED same day — the driver seam gained a unit channel (payload + header pairs) with a HeaderCarriage capability declaration, and the Go Kafka driver rides it both directions; WS/SSE and non-declaring drivers (MQTT 3.1.1) refuse pre-dispatch with ERR_REFUSED — the ruled per-cell bound, now covering only genuinely carriage-less cells); synthesis never consults it.

measured.note: 753 represented targets now carry the configuration.server requirement (Go)

entries.note: RESOLVED 2026-08-13 (R1+R5 executed same day as ruled): the exclusion no longer exists. A server is reachability configuration, not target identity; server-less operations synthesize with a configuration.server requirement and invocation challenges CONTEXT_REQUIRED (config.value, point server, path /url — the url form supplies the whole connection URL) before dispatch. ASYNC-P-04 amended; ASYNC-SS-18 pins the cell; openapi §9.3 received the same ruling for its select-or-refuse contradiction. Corpus effect: zero residual entries under this code, +201 operations, fullyRepresented 191→252 (Go).

entries.rationale: Emitted for message and server alternatives whose governing operation target was itself excluded. Never independently adjudicable; recompute after every widening that resolves a parent exclusion.

entries.note: Verify against each artifact's own declared edition. A message $ref that does not resolve in the source is presumptively upstream-defective, but must be distinguished from a resolver gap of ours (cf. finding F2, where deep nested $refs were not resolved before schema copy).

A declared foreign schema LANGUAGE (Avro, Protobuf, embedded OpenAPI Schema Objects) with no faithful JSON Schema 2020-12 conversion. The direction stays invocable through the unconstrained schema, so synthesis reports lossy, never a refusal. Single classification: doctrine-refused. Zero corpus instances after the 2026-08-13 detector correction (the earlier heuristic misclassified application/schema+json as foreign and swept in absent-payload messages); the cell is authority-derived (ASYNC-SS-07) per the anti-overfitting doctrine. NARROWED 2026-08-14 (correspondence ladder ruling, binding-specs README + §9.2): Avro left this class — an on-list declared format now derives the direction's logical schema from the Avro specification's own JSON Encoding and is fully represented (ASYNC-SS-07/SS-19/SS-20 pin the cells). The class retains only off-list languages (Protobuf — named as the reserved next correspondence — embedded OpenAPI Schema Objects, unknown JSON Schema versions).
entries.revisitTrigger: A faithful, authority-defined conversion into JSON Schema 2020-12 adopted by a binding-specification revision: for Avro/Protobuf an upstream-defined mapping; for embedded OpenAPI Schema Objects adoption of the project's existing OpenAPI dialect translator (formats/openapi translate.go) as a named conversion — the latter would re-open this entry as economically-deferred pending prevalence measurement.

entries.note: RESOLVED 2026-08-13 (codec-seam ruling, same day as opened): the reason code no longer exists. Declared binary media now carries through the artifact-authorized byte rule (canonical RFC 4648 §4 Base64 boundary, mirroring openbindings.openapi@1's raw-byte lane): the direction is invocable with the boundary schema {type: string, contentEncoding: base64}, and consumer Encode/Decode codec hooks enrich to logical values at invocation. Where a declared contract is not the boundary schema the direction accounts lossy under the new asyncapi.payload_byte_carriage code. The MC2 implementation-unsupported class this entry guarded is empty.
entries.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-13 (byte-boundary floor + codec hooks; ASYNC-SS-06/SS-19 pin the cells)

entries.note: The payload declaration is invalid under its own declared dialect (minimum: true, a non-schema properties member, Avro content referenced into a Schema Object position with no schemaFormat declared) or carries a reference the artifact leaves dangling, so it projects to an ill-formed OBI schema. Per the ASYNC-P-05 confinement sentence this is the artifact's defect, confined to exactly the affected operation: the target is invalid, siblings and the artifact synthesize. Introduced 2026-08-13 when per-operation confinement replaced whole-artifact invalid-synthesis rejection (ASYNC-SS-16 pins the cell).
entries.status: ADJUDICATED 2026-08-13; SWEEP COMPLETE 2026-08-14 (all 13 entries classified upstream-defective)

measured.note: Per-entry classification against artifact bytes, 2026-08-14: (1) ByteBardOrg/AsyncAPI.NET and LEGO/AsyncAPI.NET CompleteKafkaSpec.json (8 entries, one fixture twice) — "minimum"/"maximum" declared as JSON strings ("0", "100") in payload and headers schemas; the AsyncAPI 2.x Schema Object is a Draft-07 superset and Draft-07 §6.2 requires numbers — invalid under its own declared dialect (a lenient .NET parser example fixture). (2) microcks/microcks-spectral-ruleset pastry-orders-asyncapi-bad.yml (1 entry) — schema-level "examples" declared as a named-example OBJECT (the Message Object examples style) inside a channel parameter schema, where the dialect requires an array; the file is a lint ruleset's deliberately-broken fixture, surfaced by the routed envelope carrying parameter schemas into the input. (3) The 4 pre-existing entries (Elhebert invalid-schema fixture, panproto, specmesh, rippled) stand as adjudicated 2026-08-13. No implementation defect found: the one implementation bug this class briefly absorbed (the derivation $defs anchor) was caught by the corpus and fixed in the envelope block, and its specimens (adeo, and the schema-valid portions of these fixtures) left the class.

entries.revisitTrigger: none — invalid-under-own-dialect is the upstream's defect by definition; a future binding-specification revision adopting a named repair convention would re-open per-cause

entries.note: Declared binary media carries exact octets through the byte boundary; a declared payload contract (an Avro schema, a structural JSON schema) is not expressible at that boundary, so the direction is lossy: represented by {type: string, contentEncoding: base64}, invocable, honestly accounted. Authoring a conversion from the declared language into JSON Schema, or decoding binary payloads into logical values, would require OB-authored codec conventions the deference order refuses; the invocation encode/decode hook seam is the consumer's enrichment path (ASYNC-SS-19 pins the cell). NARROWED 2026-08-14: the revisit trigger fired — the correspondence ladder ruling incorporated the Avro JSON Encoding as a named correspondence, so an Avro-declared payload no longer rides the byte boundary in any direction (its binary wire is a codec capability that refuses when unqualified, never a base64 fallback). The remaining class is media whose declared contract is under NO named correspondence.

loadFailureClassifications.note: Artifacts refused before synthesis. Per MC2, only upstream-invalid artifacts may fail loading; every other failure is open implementation work.

A-foreign-schema-format.detail: Avro payload schemas (contentType application/avro; $ref to .avsc) copied verbatim into an OBI 2020-12 schema position. Avro 'type' values such as 'record' and 'long' are not 2020-12 type values.
A-foreign-schema-format.governingRule: openbindings.asyncapi.md §9.2 — a foreign schemaFormat does not authorize copying a non-JSON schema into an OBI JSON Schema position; the operation remains invocable and that direction is represented by an unconstrained JSON Schema unless a faithful conversion exists.

B-dialect-draft07.detail: AsyncAPI 2.x Schema Objects are Draft-07-based. Copied verbatim they carry $schema: draft-07 (OBI-D-06) and draft tuple-form 'items' arrays (OBI-D-17, 2020-12 spells this prefixItems).

C-draft07-plain-name-id.detail: Draft-07 plain-name and pointer-form $id values ('GeneralReply', '#MassCancelResponse', '#/properties/driver') copied into OBI positions, where OBI-D-05 requires an absolute URI. Note: the standalone Go client already carries an isDraft07PlainNameID grammar, so the knowledge exists but is not applied on the copy path.

D-unresolved-nested-ref.detail: Schema $refs pointing into the AsyncAPI document's #/components/schemas were copied without being resolved or rewritten, so they dangle in the OBI (OBI-D-16). Observed at deep nested positions (inside allOf, inside properties chains). Same class as the reply-by-reference defect: reference resolution incomplete at a position the resolver does not traverse. §6 of the binding spec assigns $ref resolution to the artifact processor.

upstreamInvalid.detail: Upstream test fixture authored to be an invalid schema (properties/id/minimum is a boolean). Correctly refused; belongs in the validity ledger, not the supported denominator.

invalidSynthesizedInterface.resolution: 2026-08-13: classes A-D resolved by the dialect translator + position-aware reference traversal + composition alignment (openbindings-go 77048e4/aa19355, openbindings-ts 745f404, asyncapi-client 660b82f/21b0cfb); 17 whole-artifact rejections -> 7. Remaining 7: Elhebert (deliberate invalid fixture), panproto (properties value not a schema), RobinTail (empty prefixItems), specmesh (undeclared Avro = artifact defect under its declared dialect), APIs-guru (properties member named $ref holding a string - investigate), plus 3 cyclic-schema artifacts (ripple, jeffmikels, SENERGY) awaiting $defs hoisting. All still veto siblings pending per-operation refusal narrowing.

maximumCallStackSizeExceeded.detail: TypeScript-only stack overflow where Go completes. Presumptive unguarded recursion on cyclic schemas; OBI-T-11 requires cycle handling without infinite loops for tools that resolve $ref. Distinct from F1/F2 and TS-lane only.
